name: Romeo VS Juliet
source:
It’s set in Verona, where Juliet Capulet wants to become a vampire hunter because her parents were killed by vampires when she was small. Romeo Montague and his friend Mercutio Eterna are vampires, but they keep saving Juliet from vampire attacks. 

You can choose between the vampire route with Romeo and Mercutio, or the hunter route, with your mentor Lawrence Groves and your fiance Paris Verona.  There’s also the duke of Verona Eskaras Verona, a ‘good’ vampire, Benvolio Montague, a doctor William Shakespeare, and Tybold Capulet, Juliet’s stepbrother.

[Taken from Lijakaca's [url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2013/03/news-for-april/]blogpost[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在维罗纳。朱丽叶·凯普莱特年幼时父母被吸血鬼杀害，因此她想成为一名吸血鬼猎人。

罗密欧·蒙太古和他的朋友墨丘利·永恒是吸血鬼，却一直在吸血鬼的袭击中救下朱丽叶。

你可以选择与罗密欧和墨丘利一起行动的吸血鬼路线，或与导师劳伦斯·格罗夫斯和未婚夫帕里斯·维罗纳一起行动的猎人路线。

此外还有维罗纳公爵埃斯卡拉斯·维罗纳——一名“善良”的吸血鬼；本伏里奥·蒙太古；医生威廉·莎士比亚；以及朱丽叶的继兄提伯尔特·凯普莱特。

[取自 Lijakaca 的 [url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2013/03/news-for-april/]博客文章[/url]]
